questions.question_text: What is the building block of all matter?
questions.explanation: An atom is the smallest particle of an element that can exist independently and retain all its chemical properties. It is the building block of all matter.
questions.distractor_rationale: Molecules and compounds are made of atoms. Mixtures are made of different substances mixed together without a chemical bond.

ai_context.learning_goal: To identify atoms as the fundamental building block of matter.
common_misconceptions: Thinking molecules are the fundamental building blocks.
ai_context.hint: Think of what LEGO blocks represent when building a structure.
